newsitem.title: USA: Pier 1 Imports completes public offering.
newsitem.headline: Pier 1 Imports completes public offering.

text.p: Pier 1 Imports Inc said Wednesday it has completed its public offering of $75 million in convertible subordinated notes.
The 5-3/4 percent notes due 2003 are convertible into common stock at $18.50 per share.
If the underwriter's overallotment option were exercised in full, the offering would total $86.25 million, the company said. The original filing for the offering was $50 million.
The proceeds are to be used to retire high-cost, long-term debt and to eliminate the company's term bank obligations.
